title: alkhder at AlexandriaX-2026: Context-Aware English-to-Dialectal Arabic Dialogue Translation with QLoRA-Fine-Tuned NileChat-3B
abstract: arXiv:2610.22525v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper describes team Alkhder's submission to Subtask 1 of the AlexandriaX-2026 shared task, which asks systems to translate English dialogue turns into thirteen Arabic dialects. We fine-tune NileChat-3B-Base with QLoRA on the Alexandria parallel dialogue corpus, training one set of adapter weights for all dialects. Each turn is translated conditioned on the target country and dialect, the domain, the participant roles, the speaker-addressee gender direction, and the preceding dialogue context. At inference, conversations are translated autoregressively and the model is fed its own previous outputs back as context without using any gold target-side test information. Under the constrained track, using only Alexandria data, it trains in about one hour and translates the private test set in under two hours. The system reaches a country-macro-averaged spBLEU of 20.36 and chrF++ of 36.64 on both tracks.

translated_title: alkhder 团队参加 AlexandriaX-2026 的系统：基于 QLoRA 微调 NileChat-3B 的上下文感知英语到阿拉伯方言对话翻译
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了 Alkhder 团队参加 AlexandriaX-2026 共享任务子任务 1 的提交系统，该任务要求系统将英文对话轮次翻译成十种阿拉伯语方言（共十三种方言）。我们在 Alexandria 平行对话语料库上使用 QLoRA 对 NileChat-3B-Base 进行微调，仅训练一组适配器权重即可覆盖所有方言。每轮对话的翻译均以目标国家和方言、领域、参与者角色、说话者与受话者的性别方向以及前文对话上下文为条件。在推理阶段，对话以自回归方式逐轮翻译，模型将自身先前生成的输出作为上下文反馈输入，不使用任何测试集目标侧的黄金参考信息。在受限赛道下，系统仅使用 Alexandria 数据，训练耗时约一小时，翻译私有测试集耗时不足两小时。该系统在两条赛道上均取得了国家宏平均 spBLEU 20.36、chrF++ 36.64 的成绩。
tldr: Alkhder 团队通过 QLoRA 微调 NileChat-3B-Base，以国家、方言、领域、参与者角色、性别方向及对话上下文等多重条件为输入，仅用一组适配器权重实现了英译十三种阿拉伯方言的上下文感知对话翻译，并以极低的训练成本在 AlexandriaX-2026 上取得 spBLEU 20.36 的成绩。
en_tdlr: Team Alkhder fine-tunes NileChat-3B-Base with QLoRA, conditioning each dialogue turn on target country, dialect, domain, participant roles, gender direction, and preceding context to translate English into thirteen Arabic dialects with a single set of adapter weights, achieving country-macro-averaged spBLEU of 20.36 at AlexandriaX-2026 with minimal training cost.
